blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Anatomical labels help 3D Gaussian splatting preserve vessels in cinematic renderings of CT, but the representation is still found by optimising each patient's scene, where densification decides where Gaussians go, while real-time displays cap their number. We address one part of this process: deciding where a fixed budget of B Gaussians should be placed. We propose a reusable, labelaware allocation front end that maps a patient's CT, labels and transfer function to a density over 2mm cells and draws exactly B positions from it without per-patient optimisation; the other Gaussian attributes are still fitted per patient. The front end is learned once from per-patient optimised scenes and implemented as a population-trained neural prior and an interpretable seven-parameter visibility-aware closed form (VACF). With identical attribute fitting on 20 held-out patients at 10K-100K Gaussians, both raise vessel-masked PSNR over uniform allocation by 4.5-7.1dB and over pruning a dense voxel-aligned model by 1.6-3.3dB. The neural prior does not differ significantly from per-patient optimised allocation at any budget, and VACF is within 0.6dB of it on vessels; on 19 external patients the neural prior again matches it on vessels and VACF is within 0.7dB. As an initialisation for position optimisation, VACF allocation beats per-patient densification on vessels at 10K Gaussians and, at 25K, reaches a higher vessel PSNR after 118s of optimisation than densification after 248s. Under altered rendering presets, VACF transfers to new colours and lighting but not to a label-free transfer function, whereas the neural prior shows the opposite pattern.
blocks.zh: 解剖标签有助于3D高斯滑板在CT的影视渲染中保存器皿,但通过优化每个患者的场景仍然可以找到代表,其中密度决定高斯人去向,而实时显示则封顶他们的数量. 我们处理这一进程的一个部分:决定如何安排B高斯人的固定预算。 我们提出一个可重复使用,标签意识分配的前端,将病人的CT,标签和转移功能映射到密度超过2mm的细胞,并且从中精确地划出B位置,而无需每个病人优化;其他高斯人的属性仍然符合每个病人. 前端从每个患者优化的场景中学习过一次,并作为人口训练的神经前端和可解释的七参数可见度-知觉闭合形式(VACF)执行. 在10K-100K高森岛的20名被扣留的病人身上配有相同的属性,两者都用4.5-7.1dB将船型的PSNR提升到统一分配之上,用1.6-3.3dB将一个密集的Voxel配对模型推开。 神经前科与任何预算中的每名患者优化分配额没有显著差异,VACF在0.6d范围内 B在船上;对19名外科病人来说,之前的神经病再次与船上的神经病吻合,VACF在0.7dB范围内。 作为定位优化的初始化,VACF分配在10K Gaussian在船只上击败每个病人的密度,在25K时,在118次优化后比248次密度后达到更高的PSNR。 在修改的渲染预设下,VACF转录到新的颜色和照明上,但不转录到无标签的传输功能上,而神经前传则显示相反的图案.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Cinematic rendering simulates the transport of light through a CT volume classified by a transfer function (TF). It conveys depth, shape and the spatial relations of vessels and lesions better than conventional direct volume rendering and is increasingly used for surgical planning, patient communication and education ( Eid et al., 2017 ; Dappa et al., 2016 ) , but path tracing takes far longer than interactive frame rates allow on mobile and head-mounted hardware. 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) removes this barrier at display time: a set of anisotropic Gaussians fitted to path-traced images rasterises at hundreds of frames per second. Label-aware Gaussian splatting (LAGS) ( Li et al., 2026 ) showed that anatomical labels are valuable in this process: using them during optimisation preserves fine structures such as vessels, and the resulting scenes can be explored on a standalone headset.
blocks.zh: Cinematic渲染模拟了光通过被传输函数分类的CT卷(TF)的传输. 它传递的深度,形状以及船只和损伤的空间关系优于常规的直接体积渲染,并越来越多地用于外科规划,患者的沟通和教育(Eid等人,2017年;Dappa等人,2016年),但路径跟踪比移动和头架硬件的互动帧率要长得多. 3D高斯电镀(3DGS)(Kerbl等人,2023年)在显示时消除了这个屏障:一组异同位素高斯仪,以每秒数百帧的速度安装在路径跟踪图像上. Label-aware Gaussian splateting(LAGS)(Li等人,2026年)表明解剖标签在这个过程中很有价值:在优化过程中使用这些标签可以保存船只等精细结构,由此形成的场景可以在一个独立的头盔上进行探索.

blocks.en: The Gaussian representation itself, however, is still found by optimising each patient’s scene. Starting from an initial set of Gaussians, densification and pruning decide, over tens of thousands of iterations on path-traced views, where Gaussians are needed and how many there are, and this search is repeated for every patient and every TF ( Li et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . The resulting count is a by-product of thresholds, whereas the devices that motivate the approach impose a fixed budget B B on the number of Gaussians that can be stored, streamed, sorted and blended per frame. Feed-forward models such as Render-FM ( Gao et al., 2026a ) avoid per-patient optimisation but place one Gaussian per foreground voxel, so their count follows the size of the organ (50K–800K Gaussians in Render-FM). Neither approach answers where a fixed number of Gaussians should go.
blocks.zh: 然而,高斯人代表本身仍然通过优化每个病人的场景找到。 从最初的一组高斯人开始,密度化和挤压决定,数以万计的重复论路径追踪观点,其中需要高斯人和有多少人,每名患者和每个TF(李等人,2026年;李等人,2025年)都会重复这种搜索. 由此产生的计数是阈值的副产物,而激发该方法的装置则对每个帧可以存储,流线,排序和混合的高斯人数量规定了固定预算B. Render-FM(Gao et al., 2026a)等饲料前置模型避免了每患者的优化,而是将每个前置阴道放置一个高斯琴,因此它们的计数跟随器官大小(50K–800K高斯琴在Render-FM). 无论是哪种方法都无法回答固定数量高斯人应该去的地方.

blocks.en: We address this one part of the process. Our premise is that where a scene needs its Gaussians is largely predictable from the anatomy and the rendering setup, so that it can be learned once from optimised scenes of other patients and reused. We propose a label-aware allocation front end : from a patient’s CT, labels and TF it computes a density over 2 mm cells and draws exactly B B Gaussian positions from it, in seconds and without per-patient optimisation (Fig. 1 ). The front end takes over the placement decisions that densification makes; it does not estimate colour, opacity or shape. Every complete scene reported in this paper still has these attributes fitted to path-traced views of the patient (about 2 min on a GPU), optionally together with the positions; we do not generate complete 3DGS scenes in one forward pass.
blocks.zh: 我们处理这一进程的这一部分。 我们的前提是,一个场景需要它的 高斯人从解剖学和渲染设置上基本上可以预测,这样就可以从其他病人的优化场景中学习一次,再利用一次. 我们提出一个具有标签意识的配置前端:从患者的CT,标签和TF计算出一个超过2mm的细胞的密度,并从中精确地画出B高斯的姿势,以秒为单位,没有每个患者的优化(图1)。 前端接管了密度增大后作出的放置决定;它不估计颜色,不透明或形状. 本文中报道的每一个完整的场景仍然有这些属性,适合患者的路径跟踪视图(约2分钟在GPU上),可选地与位置并列;我们不会在一个前传生成完整的3DGS场景.

blocks.en: Figure 1: The problem. (a) Cinematic rendering path-traces a CT volume classified by a transfer function (TF); it conveys depth and shape but takes minutes per frame. (b) 3D Gaussian splatting renders such scenes in real time, but head-mounted displays, tablets and browsers cap the number of Gaussians B B , so their positions must be chosen. Shown are B = 10,000 B=10{,}000 positions (in an 18 mm coronal slab) drawn uniformly over the organ and by our visibility-aware closed form (VACF), which concentrates them on vessels and the visible surface. (c) With identical fitting of all other attributes, the two allocations give different images: crops of a held-out view, absolute error and crop PSNR (MSD test patient 372); and vessel-masked PSNR against the budget on 20 held-out patients, where the neural prior matches the per-patient oracle, VACF comes close, and uniform allocation stays 4.5–7.1 dB lower.
blocks.zh: 图 1:问题. (a) 电影渲染路径跟踪按传输函数分类的CT卷(TF);它传递深度和形状,但每个帧需要几分钟。 (b) 3D高斯滑板使这种场景成为实时的,但头挂显示,平板和浏览器封顶了高斯B的数量,所以必须选择其位置. 显示的是B = 1万 B = 10{,} 000 个位置(在一个18毫米的日冕板上),统一划过器官和通过我们的能见度-知觉闭合形式(VACF),这些位置集中在船只和可见表面. (c) 这两种分配方式与所有其他特征完全一致,呈现出不同的图像:被搁置视线的作物、绝对错误和作物PSNR(MSD测试病人372);以及20名被搁置病人的船型PSNR预算,其中神经前科与每名病人的甲骨文相符,VACF接近,统一分配维持4.5-7.1分贝。

blocks.en: We implement the front end in two ways that share their supervision and objective and differ in model class. Both are trained to reproduce oracle densities , the per-cell counts of Gaussians in per-patient optimised scenes of training patients. A population-trained neural prior , a 3D U-Net on ten cell-level inputs, can represent any dependence of these densities on the inputs. A visibility-aware closed form (VACF) has seven parameters: six weights for the label fractions and TF gradient of a cell, and an exponent on the visibility of the cell from the viewing sphere. It is inspectable and its failure modes can be stated in advance. We evaluate both under a protocol in which all methods share the same attribute fitting and differ only in where the B B Gaussians are, and let the results establish their respective strengths.
blocks.zh: 我们以两种方式执行前端,即分享他们的监督和客观,在模范类上有所不同. 两人都受过训练, 由人口训练的神经元前,一个基于10个细胞级输入的3D U-Net,可以代表这些密度对输入的任何依赖. 一个能见度-认知闭合形式(VACF)有7个参数:一个细胞的标签分数和TF梯度的6个权重,以及从查看球对细胞的能见度的表示. 该系统可以检查,故障模式可以事先说明。 根据一项协议,所有方法都具有相同的属性,只有在B·高斯教徒所在的地方才有不同之处。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: 1. A reusable, label-aware allocation front end for budget-constrained Gaussian splatting of cinematic CT, which separates the placement of Gaussians from the fitting of their attributes, together with an equal-budget evaluation protocol that isolates the effect of placement. 2. Two implementations learned once from per-patient optimised scenes : a population-trained neural prior and an interpretable visibility-aware closed form. 3. Evidence on held-out and external patients. At equal budgets, both raise anatomical rendering quality far above uniform placement and above pruning a dense voxel-aligned model; the neural prior does not differ significantly from the per-patient optimised allocation, on 20 held-out patients and on 19 external patients from another centre. As an initialisation, the closed-form allocation lets position optimisation surpass per-patient densification on vessels at 10K Gaussians, and at 25K reach a higher vessel PSNR in less than half the optimisation time. Rendering presets show the limits of each implementation: the closed form fails when appearance no longer follows the labels, and the neural prior fails when the TF changes the contrast it was trained on. 4. Supporting analysis. Per-patient optimised allocations at 25K–200K Gaussians differ about as much as two optimisation seeds do, as a simple power-law model predicts, which supports drawing different budgets from one density per patient; and the main systematic difference between optimised allocations and anatomy-only rules is the visibility of each cell.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 1. 可重复使用、具有标签意识的分配前端用于预算限制的高斯族对电影剧情的浮雕,将高斯族的布置与其特征的配置区分开来,同时采用将布置效果隔离开来的平等预算评价协议。 2. 从每个病人最优化的场景中汲取了两次执行经验:经过人口训练的神经前和可解释的能见度-感知闭塞形式。 3. 关于被扣留病人和外部病人的证据。 在预算相等的情况下,两者都提高解剖质量,远远高于统一安置,并高于使用密集的阴道调节模型;神经前置与每个病人优化分配、20名被滞留病人和19名来自另一个中心的外部病人没有显著区别。 作为一种初始化,封闭式分配允许在10K高森岛的船舶上将优化定位超过每个病人的密度,在25K时,在优化配置时间不到一半的时间内到达一个更高的船舶PSNR。 渲染预设显示每个执行的极限:当外观不再遵循标签时,关闭的形式失败,当TF改变它所训练的对比时,神经前的失败. 4. 辅助分析。 25K - 200K的病人优化拨款 高斯人与两个优化种子的大小不同,如简单的功率法模型预测,支持从每个病人一个密度中抽取不同的预算;优化分配和唯解剖规则的主要系统差异是每个细胞的能见度.

blocks.en: A reusable, label-aware allocation front end for budget-constrained Gaussian splatting of cinematic CT, which separates the placement of Gaussians from the fitting of their attributes, together with an equal-budget evaluation protocol that isolates the effect of placement.
blocks.zh: 一个可重复使用,具有标签意识的配置前端,用于预算限制的高斯滑板影院CT,它将高斯的放置与其属性的配位区分开来,同时还有将放置效果隔离开来的平等预算评价协议.

blocks.en: Two implementations learned once from per-patient optimised scenes : a population-trained neural prior and an interpretable visibility-aware closed form.
blocks.zh: 从每个病人最优化的场景中汲取了两次执行经验:经过人口训练的神经前和可解释的能见度-感知闭塞形式。

blocks.en: Evidence on held-out and external patients. At equal budgets, both raise anatomical rendering quality far above uniform placement and above pruning a dense voxel-aligned model; the neural prior does not differ significantly from the per-patient optimised allocation, on 20 held-out patients and on 19 external patients from another centre. As an initialisation, the closed-form allocation lets position optimisation surpass per-patient densification on vessels at 10K Gaussians, and at 25K reach a higher vessel PSNR in less than half the optimisation time. Rendering presets show the limits of each implementation: the closed form fails when appearance no longer follows the labels, and the neural prior fails when the TF changes the contrast it was trained on.

Per-patient optimised allocations at 25K–200K Gaussians differ about as much as two optimisation seeds do, as a simple power-law model predicts, which supports drawing different budgets from one density per patient; and the main systematic difference between optimised allocations and anatomy-only rules is the visibility of each cell.

blocks.en: All baselines are our own implementations under the common protocol. The dense voxel-aligned baseline adopts Render-FM’s placement (one Gaussian per foreground cell) but is fitted per patient; it is not the Render-FM network. We do not evaluate the official LAGS pipeline: our per-patient models use generic absolute-gradient densification ( Ye et al., 2024 ) , and label-aware training as in LAGS is complementary to, and could start from, our allocation.
blocks.zh: 所有基线都是我们根据共同议定书执行的。 密集的Voxel-accessed基线采用Render-FM的放置(每个前缘细胞一个高斯人),但每个病人都安装;它不是Render-FM网络。 我们不评估官方的LAGS管道:我们的每名病人模型使用通用的绝对梯度密度(Ye等人,2024年),以及像LAGS那样的具有标签意识的培训是对我们的分配的补充,并且可以从分配开始。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: LAGS ( Li et al., 2026 ) introduced label-aware densification and rasterisation for path-traced medical volumes with a mixed-reality viewer; its budget study (50K–200K Gaussians; Table IV of Li et al., 2026 ) reported gains of 2.7–9.2 dB over vanilla 3DGS at equal counts, attributed to a better distribution of Gaussians, which motivates the present work. ClipGS and XClipGS add interactive clipping ( Li et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026b ) ; DDGS-CT targets X-ray rendering from CT ( Gao et al., 2024 ) . All of these optimise each scene. Render-FM ( Gao et al., 2026a ) is a feed-forward model trained on 991 TotalSegmentator CTs that predicts one 6D Gaussian per foreground voxel from the CT, masks and TF, without per-patient optimisation but without control of the count. Expressive kernels (6DGS, 7DGS, Universal Beta Splatting) reduce counts as a side effect of the kernel ( Gao et al., 2025a ; Gao et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) ; allocation is complementary to the kernel.
blocks.zh: LAGS(Li等人,2026年)为路径跟踪医学卷引入了具有混合真实性查看器的标签意识密度和光栅化;其预算研究(50K–200K Gaussians;Li等人的表四,2026年)报告在平等计数上比香草3DGS得到2.7–9.2 dB的增益,这归功于高斯人分布的更好,推动了目前的工作. ClipGS和XClipGS增加交互式剪辑(Li等人,2025年;Gao等人,2026年b);DDGS-CT目标X光从CT(Gao等人,2024年)中渲染. 所有这些都优化了每个场景。 Render-FM(Gao等人,2026年a)是经过991TotalSegmentator CTs培训的饲料前进模型,它预测从CT,口罩和TF中每个前缘阴道有一个6D Gaussian,没有每个病人优化,但没有控制计数. 表达内核(6DGS,7DGS,Universal Beta Platting)作为内核的副作用减少计数(Gao等人,2025a); Gao et al., 2025b; Liu et al., 2026; 分配是对内核的补充.

blocks.en: For natural scenes, compactness is pursued by pruning with importance scores such as LightGaussian’s global significance ( Fan et al., 2024 ) , by growth under a budget as in Taming 3DGS ( Mallick et al., 2024 ) , by Markov-chain relocation ( Kheradmand et al., 2024 ) , by densification on absolute gradients ( Ye et al., 2024 ) and by codebook compression ( Lee et al., 2024 ) . All operate per scene by optimisation. We use significance pruning of a dense voxel-aligned model as a baseline, and budget-capped growth to build per-patient references.
blocks.zh: 对于自然场景,追求紧凑性的方式是用重要分数如Light Gausian的全球意义(Fan等人,2024年),在预算下的增长如Taming 3DGS(Mallick等人,2024年),Markov-chain迁移(Kheradmand等人,2024年),绝对梯度的密度(Ye等人,2024年)和编码本压缩(Lee等人,2024年). 所有操作每个场景 通过优化。 我们用一个密集的阴道调节模型作为基线,并以预算为上限的增长来建立每个病人的参考。

blocks.en: Generalisable models predict Gaussians from images or volumes in one pass ( Charatan et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2026a ) ; they typically tie Gaussians to pixels or voxels. Our front end decides positions under a budget and could precede such a decoder; in this work, attributes are fitted per patient.
blocks.zh: 通用模型预测 高斯人从图像或卷成一经(Charatan等人,2024年;Gao等人,2026a年);他们通常将高斯人与像素或狐狸联系起来. 我们的前端根据预算决定立场,并且可以在这种解码器之前;在这项工作中,每个病人都有相应的属性。

blocks.en: The allocation model of Section 3.3 is a finite-cell form of asymptotic quantisation theory, in which the optimal density of quantisation points is a power of the source density ( Zador, 1982 ; Gersho, 1979 ) . Importance-driven and visibility-driven volume rendering ( Viola et al., 2005 ; Correa and Ma, 2011 ) use related notions of how visible a structure is, but to classify or emphasise structures, not to represent a volume with a fixed number of primitives.
blocks.zh: 第3.3节的分配模型是不对称定量理论的一种有限细胞形式,其中定量点的最佳密度是源密度的功率(Zador,1982;Gersho,1979. 重要性驱动和能见度驱动的体积渲染(Viola等人,2005年;Correa和Ma,2011年)使用相关概念来描述一个结构的能见度,但用于分类或强调结构,不代表具有固定数量原始物的体积.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Fig. 2 summarises the method: oracle allocations from per-patient optimisation on training patients (Section 3.2 ), two allocators learned from them (Sections 3.4 – 3.6 ), and their deployment on a new patient (Section 3.7 ).
blocks.zh: 图2概括了方法:每个病人优化对培训病人的预言分配(第3.2节),从他们那里学到的两名分配者(第3.4至3.6节),以及在新病人身上的部署(第3.7节)。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Method. (a) For each training patient, CT and labels are classified by a TF and path-traced from 256 training views on a sphere; a per-patient 3DGS model (teacher) optimised on these views defines the oracle allocation, the count of its Gaussians per 2 mm cell. A simple distortion model (Proposition 1 ) suggests that one density per patient can serve a range of budgets. (b) The allocation front end predicts this density from per-cell features without per-patient optimisation, implemented as a visibility-aware closed form (VACF) with six tissue weights and a visibility exponent, or as a neural prior (3D U-Net). Both are fitted to the oracle densities of the training patients by minimising the KL divergence (dashed) and then frozen. (c) For a new patient and any budget B B , exactly B B positions are drawn from the density; colour, opacity, scale and rotation, and optionally the positions, are then fitted to path-traced views of that patient, and the result is rendered by splatting in real time. All images are data of MSD test patient 372: CT slice with labels (vessels red, tumour yellow, liver outline green), teacher Gaussians (coronal projection, darker = more opaque), cell features (one axial 2 mm slice), densities (22 mm axial slab, square-root scale), sampled positions (18 mm coronal slab) and a rendering after VACF allocation with optimised positions at 10K Gaussians.

blocks.en: 3.4 Neural allocation prior

blocks.en: The neural prior is a 3D U-Net (MONAI ( Cardoso et al., 2022 ) ; channels 24–192, three downsamplings, residual units) whose output logits, normalised by a softmax over the cells that carry a tissue label, are the allocation density. Its ten cell-level inputs are CT intensity; the fractions of parenchyma, tumour and vessels in three calibre classes ( r < 1.5 r<1.5 , 1.5 1.5 – 3 3 , ≥ 3 \geq 3 mm; Section 4.5 ); the TF extinction and its gradient magnitude; the visibility V c V_{c} of ( 2 ), computed by marching 48 rays per cell through the TF extinction on the GPU; and depth below the liver surface. It is trained on the 56 training patients to minimise ∑ patients KL ( P ^ oracle ∥ P ) , \sum_{\text{patients}}{\rm KL}\big(\hat{P}^{\rm oracle}\,\big\|\,P\big), (3) the negative log-likelihood of the teachers’ Gaussian positions up to a constant, where P ^ oracle \hat{P}^{\rm oracle} is the raw, unsmoothed oracle density (Appendix A ). blocks.en: 3.6 How the two implementations relate
blocks.zh: 3.6 国家 这两项执行工作之间的关系

blocks.en: Both allocators are trained on the same targets with the same objective and are applied in the same way; they differ in hypothesis class. VACF is a pointwise function of a subset of the neural prior’s inputs (label fractions, TF gradient, visibility), a fixed monotone function of a weighted sum modulated by visibility, so the neural prior can in principle represent it. Its six weights and visibility exponent can be read and compared across cell sizes, and the conditions under which it will fail follow from its form. The neural prior can represent interactions and spatial context that the closed form cannot, such as the arrangement of vessels around a cell, at the cost of 2.7 million parameters and of learning whatever its inputs encode about the training TF. Which of these trade-offs matters is an empirical question, answered in Sections 5.1 – 5.4 .
blocks.zh: 两种分配器都接受目标相同的培训,目标相同,应用方式也相同;在假说类上不同. VACF是神经前输入的一个子集(标签分数,TF梯度,能见度)的指针函数,是由能见度调制的加权总和的固定单调函数,所以神经前输入原则上可以代表它. 它的6个重量和能见度激发符可以跨细胞大小读取和比较,其失败的条件会从形态上产生. 神经前置可以代表封闭形式无法进行的互动和空间背景,例如以270万个参数为代价安排细胞周围的容器,以及学习其培训TF编码的任何投入。 第5.1至5.4节回答说,这些权衡中哪些是经验问题。

blocks.en: 3.7 Deployment and evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 3.7 部署和评价程序

blocks.en: Exactly B B positions are drawn by systematic resampling of the density, which yields integer counts per cell summing to B B , with stratified jitter inside each cell. Gaussians are initialised at these positions with an isotropic scale from the distance to their three nearest neighbours and colour and opacity from the TF; colour, opacity, scale and rotation are then optimised for 15K iterations on the patient’s training views without densification or pruning. For evaluation, positions stay frozen, and the protocol is identical for every allocator, so that differences in image quality are due to placement alone. In deployment, positions may be optimised as well (Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 精确的B位置是通过对密度进行系统重新取样来绘制的,这个密度产生每个细胞向B B 的整数,每个细胞内分层的振动。 高斯人在这些位置上被宣布为异色人种,从距离到他们最近的三个邻居,从TF的颜色和不透明度;然后在病人的训练观点上,将颜色、不透明度、比例和旋转的15K倍数优化,而不密度或穿插。 就评价而言,位置保持不变,每个分配器的操作规程相同,因此图像质量的差异仅是由于放置所致。 在部署时,职位也可以优化(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: 3.8 Baselines and references
blocks.zh: 3.8 基线和参考文献

blocks.en: Uniform voxels : B B foreground voxels drawn uniformly. TF density : density proportional to the TF extinction. Anatomy heuristic : label weights parenchyma/vessel/tumour = 1 / 4 / 2 =1/4/2 plus the normalised TF gradient, the strongest hand-designed rule in our pilot study. Segmentation-free : Frangi vesselness ( Frangi et al., 1998 ) and multiscale CT gradient inside the rendered region, fitted like VACF. Dense model, top- B B : a dense voxel-aligned per-patient model with one Gaussian per foreground 2 mm cell, as in Render-FM’s placement, fitted with frozen positions, from which the top- B B Gaussians are kept by opacity or by LightGaussian global significance ( Fan et al., 2024 ) and then refitted under the common protocol. The oracle density and per-case 3DGS at B B require per-patient optimisation and are references, not competitors.
blocks.zh: 统一排水瓶:B型前置排水瓶统一抽取. TF密度 :密度与TF灭绝成正比. 解剖学heuristic:标签重量 parenchyma/vessel/tumour = 1 / 4 / 2 = 1/4/2 加上正常的 TF 梯度,是我们试点研究中最强的手工设计规则. 无分解:Frangi船体(Frangi等人,1998年)和成形区域内的多级CT梯度,装配如VACF。 Dense模型,顶部-B B :一个密集的Voxel对齐的人均病人模型,每个前台2毫米电池一个高斯琴,如Render-FM的布置,装有冷冻姿势,从中,顶部-B高斯琴通过不透明或轻高斯琴全球意义保存(Fan等人,2024年),然后根据共同协议进行重置. B的甲骨文密度和每例3DGS需要每个病人优化,是参考,而不是竞争对手.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Cinematic ground truth
blocks.zh: 4.1 电影真相

blocks.en: CT volumes are resampled to 1 mm isotropic voxels and cropped to the liver with a 6 mm margin. A TF maps CT and labels to extinction σ \sigma and RGB single-scattering albedo (Section 4.3 ). Images are rendered with Mitsuba 3 ( Jakob et al., 2022 ) (volumetric path tracing in a heterogeneous medium, Henyey–Greenstein phase function with g = 0.2 g=0.2 , environment map plus one directional key light, 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels, 35 ∘ field of view). Cameras lie on a sphere that frames the region: 256 training views at 1024 samples per pixel (spp) and 16 held-out test views at 2048 spp.

blocks.en: 4.2 Data
blocks.zh: 4.2 数据

blocks.en: Development and internal test. We use the hepatic-vessel task of the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) ( Antonelli et al., 2022 ) : 303 portal-venous contrast-enhanced CT scans with annotations of hepatic vessels and tumours. Because resampling thick slices to 1 mm only interpolates, we keep scans with slice thickness ≤ 2.5 \leq 2.5 mm (86 of 303; 194 scans have 5 mm slices and none lie between 2.5 and 3.75 mm). Liver masks are obtained with TotalSegmentator ( Wasserthal et al., 2023 ) . Patients are split into 56 training, 10 validation and 20 test patients.

We exclude one scan with 4 mm slices (slice thickness of the remaining 19: 1.0–2.5 mm), map the portal and hepatic venous systems to the MSD vessel label, restricted to the liver dilated by 5 mm because MSD does not annotate the extrahepatic vena cava, and map all liver tumours to the tumour label; the liver mask is again taken from TotalSegmentator. The annotation protocol differs from MSD (for example, five patients have no tumour and the venous system is not delineated in all patients). IRCADb was used once, for the final evaluation, with all allocators frozen.

blocks.en: 4.3 Rendering presets
blocks.zh: 4.3 渲染预设

blocks.en: Preset A , used for all fitting, training and model selection, is a label-aware TF: parenchyma σ = 0.012 ​ mm − 1 \sigma=0.012\,{\rm mm^{-1}} , vessels 0.45 0.45 and tumour 0.10 0.10 with reddish vessels and tan parenchyma, parenchyma and vessel extinction modulated by CT intensity (40–200 HU), and class occupancies smoothed by a 0.6-voxel Gaussian to avoid staircases. Preset B keeps a label-aware TF but changes everything else: denser bluish parenchyma ( σ = 0.022 \sigma=0.022 ), less dense whitish vessels ( 0.30 0.30 ), green tumour ( 0.16 0.16 ), a shifted intensity window (60–220 HU), and a cooler key light from the opposite side. Preset C is label-free: inside the liver, extinction and albedo are piecewise-linear functions of the CT intensity relative to the patient’s median liver intensity (after Gaussian smoothing restricted to the liver), so that enhancing structures more than about 25 HU above the parenchyma appear as dense red vessels and hypodense tissue appears faint yellow, whether or not they are labelled; lighting is as in preset A. A relative window is needed because contrast enhancement varies widely between patients (median vessel intensity 116–209 HU on the test set). Presets B and C were rendered for the first 10 test patients and never used for any decision. For each preset the oracle uses teachers trained on that preset’s images, and the allocators’ inputs (extinction, gradient, visibility) are recomputed under that preset.

blocks.en: 4.4 Model selection and use of the test data
blocks.zh: 4.4 测试数据的模型选择和使用

blocks.en: All design decisions (TF, rendering protocol, teacher settings, the form of VACF, its fitted parameters and the network) were made on training and validation patients. The MSD test set was used in two rounds. A first set of frozen allocators (an anatomy-only closed form fitted to smoothed teacher targets, among others) was evaluated first; its failure and the oracle gap it revealed motivated the visibility analysis, which was carried out on training patients only, and the final VACF and network were developed on training and validation patients and frozen (with checksums) before the second evaluation. After that evaluation we found that the neural prior’s inference normalised its density over every cell with non-zero extinction instead of the labelled cells used by its training loss, which placed about 20% of its budget in cells without any tissue label, where teachers place about 1%. We corrected the inference to match training, without retraining or any other change, and report the corrected prior throughout; the uncorrected prior was 0.54 dB below the oracle on vessels at 10K. All later experiments on the MSD test set (component and input ablations, cell size, positions, perceptual metrics) added methods or metrics but did not change the frozen allocators. Two kinds of test data were never seen by any decision: the external IRCADb patients and presets B and C.
blocks.zh: 所有设计决定(TF,渲染协议,教师设置,VACF的形式,它的配对参数和网络)都是关于培训和验证病人的. MSD测试集分两轮使用. 首先评估了第一套冷冻分泌器(一种安装在平滑的教师目标上的解剖器的封闭式),其故障和甲骨文缺口揭示了能见度分析的动机,该分析只针对培训病人进行,最后的VACF和网络是在第二次评估前开发的关于培训和验证病人的,并冷冻(带有校验和). 在评估后,我们发现神经前推论使其在每一个细胞上的密度常态化为非零灭绝,而不是其训练损失所用的标注细胞。 标注细胞将预算的20%放在没有任何组织标签的细胞中,教师在那里放置了大约1%。 我们纠正了推论,以匹配培训,而不进行再培训或任何其他改变,并报告先前的纠正情况;10K时,未改正者低于船只上的甲骨文0.54分贝。 之后在MSD测试集上的所有实验(组件和输入放大,细胞大小,位置,感知度量表)都添加了方法或度量,但没有改变冷冻分配器. 两种测试数据从未被任何决定看到:外部IRCADb患者和预设B和C.

blocks.en: 4.5 Metrics and statistics
blocks.zh: 4.5 计量和统计

blocks.en: For each test view we compute PSNR and SSIM and, from projected label maps obtained by ray-marching the label occupancies with the same extinction, region masks: foreground (accumulated opacity > 0.05 >0.05 ), vessels (projected vessel weight > 0.3 >0.3 ), vessel-calibre strata (visible vessel pixels dominated by one radius class), parenchyma and tumour. The radius of a vessel voxel is the largest distance to the vessel wall within its 7 × 7 × 7 7\times 7\times 7 -voxel ( ± 3 \pm 3 mm) neighbourhood, which reaches the centreline radius for vessels up to about 4 mm in radius and exceeds 3 mm for all larger ones, so every voxel of a vessel receives its correct class; non-vessel voxels take the class of the nearest vessel voxel. A thin branch within 3 mm of a larger vessel therefore inherits the larger class, so the thin stratum ( r < 1.5 r<1.5 mm) contains only thin branches away from larger vessels: it can miss thin segments near bifurcations but does not include parts of larger vessels. Region PSNRs pool squared error over the 16 test views of a patient. Because the clinical purpose of the rendering is to show the anatomy, we report vessel-masked and thin-vessel ( r < 1.5 r<1.5 mm) PSNR alongside foreground PSNR. We also report LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) (AlexNet features, full images) and a vessel-structure metric, centreline ridge recall (CR80): reference centrelines are the skeleton of the ground-truth ridge map (scale-normalised Hessian ridge strength at 1–2.5 pixels, maximum over colour channels) inside the projected vessel mask; CR80 is the fraction of centreline pixels at which the rendering’s ridge strength reaches 80% of the ground truth’s, overall and for thin vessels. It measures whether a branch is drawn with its contrast, which PSNR does not separate from small errors elsewhere. Comparisons are paired over patients (never over views): two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm correction ( Holm, 1979 ) within each comparison family (one pair of methods across metrics and budgets), and 95% percentile-bootstrap confidence intervals of the mean difference (10,000 resamples). Budgets are B ∈ { 10 ​ K , 25 ​ K , 50 ​ K , 100 ​ K } B\in\{10\text{K},25\text{K},50\text{K},100\text{K}\} on the MSD test set and { 10 ​ K , 25 ​ K , 50 ​ K } \{10\text{K},25\text{K},50\text{K}\} elsewhere. With 10 patients (presets), the smallest attainable Holm-adjusted p p is about 0.02. Not finding a significant difference does not establish equivalence; we therefore report confidence intervals alongside every comparison. All paired comparisons at every budget are listed in the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: 对于每个测试视图,我们计算出PSNR和SSIM,并且从射线图上测得的具有同样灭绝的标签位置的预测标签图中,区域遮罩:前缘(累积不透明 > 0.05 > 0.05),船只(预计船只重量 > 0.3 > 0.3),船只口径层(以一个半径级为主的可见船只像素),parenchyma和肿瘤。 舰ox的半径是其7×7×7 7\7\7\7\7\7\7\7\7\7\7\7\7\7±7±7±7±7±3 mmpm mm3mm)街区内与舰 wall壁的最大距离,其达到半径约4mm的舰 vessels中心线半径,所有较大舰 vessel的舰el均超过3mm,因此舰el的每艘舰el都会得到正确的等级;非舰ox的舰ox取其最近的舰ox的等级. 因此,在较大船只3毫米范围内的细枝可继承较大种类,因此细层(r < 1.5 r < 1.5毫米)只包含较大型船只外的细枝:它可能在两足附近漏掉细枝,但不包括较大船只的部分部分. 地区 PSNRs 池对一个病人的16个测试视图的平方误差. 由于渲染的临床目的是展示解剖学,因此我们报告船身有薄膜和薄膜(r < 1.5 r < 1.5 mm)PSNR与前缘PSNR. 我们还报告LPIPS(Zhang等人,2018年)(AlexNet特征,全图像)和船体结构的度量衡,中线脊召回(CR80):参考中线是预测的船面罩内地真脊图的骨架(比例正常的黑森山脊强度为1-2.5像素,最大超过彩色通道);CR80是中线像素的一小部分,其中渲染的脊强度总体和薄船都达到地面真伪的80%. 它衡量一个分支是否与其对比,而PSNR并不与其他地方的小错误分开。 比较在病人(绝不是视线)之间进行配对:在每一个比较家族中,双侧的Wilcoxon与Holm校正(Holm,1979年)的签名排名测试(一对方法跨度量和预算),平均差值的95%(10 000个复标)。 预算在MSD测试集上为B{{{}10K,25K,50K,100K}}B\in{}10\\text{K},25\text{K},50\text{K}100\text{K},在MSD测试集上为{10K,25K,50K}}{{10\text{K},25\text{K},50\text{K}在别处. 有10个病人(预科),最小可实现的Holm调整p约为0.02. 没有找到重大区别并不能确立等同性;因此,我们报告每一次比较时的信任间隔。 每个预算的所有配对比较都列在补充材料中。

blocks.en: 4.6 Implementation
blocks.zh: 4.6 执行情况

blocks.en: Rendering used Mitsuba 3.9 ( cuda_ad_rgb ); 3DGS used gsplat 1.6 with PyTorch 2.14. Experiments ran on an RTX 5070 Ti laptop GPU and RTX 4090 GPUs. Median times on an RTX 4090: cell features including visibility about 7 s per patient, allocation with VACF 0.6 s and with the neural prior 4.9 s, and attribute fitting with frozen positions 2.0 min; a teacher takes about 8 min. All of these come in addition to path tracing the training views, which every method in this paper requires. Repeating a fit with the same seed changed vessel-masked PSNR by 0.03 dB on average (maximum 0.36 dB over 320 repeated fits), which bounds the run-to-run noise of the protocol.
blocks.zh: 渲染使用Mitsuba 3.9(cuda_ad_rgb);3DGS使用gsplat 1.6与PyTorch 2.14. 实验运行在一台RTX 5070 Ti笔记本电脑GPU和RTX 4090 GPU上. 在RTX 4090上的中间时间:细胞特征,包括每个病人约7s的可见度,用VACF 0.6s和神经前4.9s分配,与冷冻姿势相匹配的属性为2.0分钟;教师大约需要8分钟. 所有这些都是在追踪培训观点的路径之外提出的,这是本文中每一种方法都需要的。 重复一个装有相同种子的套装,平均以0.03 dB(最大0.36 dB大于320 重复套装)改变船型的PSNR,这限制了协议的运行中噪音.

blocks.en: Both allocators are far above uniform voxels and pruning a dense model. The neural prior improves vessel-masked PSNR over uniform voxels by 7.1, 5.4, 5.0 and 5.1 dB at 10K, 25K, 50K and 100K, and VACF by + 6.46 +6.46 [ 6.01 , 6.90 ] [6.01,6.90] , + 5.18 +5.18 , + 4.86 +4.86 and + 4.50 +4.50 dB. Over the dense model pruned by LightGaussian significance, VACF gains + 2.67 +2.67 [ 1.94 , 3.39 ] [1.94,3.39] , + 1.80 +1.80 , + 1.63 +1.63 and + 2.52 +2.52 dB on vessels and 4.5–5.4 dB on thin vessels. LPIPS and centreline recall agree with the PSNR results (Table 3 ): uniform voxels are worst, and the neural prior and VACF are closest to the oracle (LPIPS at 10K: 0.021 for uniform voxels, 0.016 for the anatomy heuristic, 0.013 for VACF, 0.011 for the neural prior and the oracle). blocks.en: In deployment the allocated positions need not stay fixed. We therefore asked whether allocation still matters when positions are optimised together with the other attributes, and how the result compares with per-case 3DGS, which grows its Gaussians from scratch by densification (Table 5 , Fig. 5 ). This experiment was run for VACF, the oracle and two baselines. Optimising positions (15K iterations, no densification) improves every allocation, VACF by + 1.93 +1.93 dB on vessels and + 3.18 +3.18 dB on thin vessels at 10K. Allocation still matters: VACF with optimised positions stays 2.43 2.43 [ 2.18 , 2.67 ] [2.18,2.67] dB above uniform voxels with optimised positions on vessels at 10K and 0.56 0.56 dB at 50K. Among anatomy-aware initialisations the differences shrink: VACF and the oracle are within 0.15 dB of each other, and the anatomy heuristic is 0.19 dB higher than VACF on vessels but 0.30 dB lower on thin vessels and 0.27 dB lower on the foreground at 10K (all p < 0.01 p<0.01 ); at 50K none of these differences is significant. VACF with optimised positions exceeds per-case 3DGS at the same budget on vessels ( + 1.12 +1.12 [ 0.97 , 1.26 ] [0.97,1.26] dB) and thin vessels ( + 0.81 +0.81 dB) at 10K, is level at 50K, and is 0.15–0.22 dB lower on the foreground. It is also faster: at 25K Gaussians on 10 test patients, VACF with optimised positions reaches 41.9 dB on vessels in 118 s, whereas per-case 3DGS reaches 41.3 dB in 248 s and attains the former value within its 30K iterations in only one of the ten patients (Fig. 5 a).

blocks.en: Under preset C, appearance no longer follows the labels: on these 10 patients, 34% of the voxels rendered as dense vessel (extinction > 0.2 ​ mm − 1 >0.2\,{\rm mm^{-1}} ) carry no vessel label, 25% of labelled vessel voxels are not rendered as dense, the share of the total extinction that lies in labelled vessels drops from 32% under preset A to 18%, and tumours, which are hypodense, become faint instead of dense. The oracle follows the rendering: under preset C it spends 31% of its budget in the 2 mm shell below the liver surface (18% under preset A), 5% on labelled vessels (13%) and 4% on tumour (12%). VACF, whose weights encode the relation between labels and appearance of preset A, still spends 22% on tumour and 13% on labelled vessels, and only 9% on the surface shell; its foreground errors concentrate along the liver surface (Fig. 6 e). The neural prior can follow the extinction instead, but it relies on the extinction contrast it saw in training: preset C keeps a vessel-to-parenchyma extinction contrast similar to preset A, whereas preset B lowers it from about 37:1 to about 14:1, and this is where the prior with TF inputs under-serves thin vessels.

blocks.en: 5.5 What drives allocation

blocks.en: On the test set the oracle density beats uniform voxels by 7.1 dB of vessel-masked PSNR at 10K, and the anatomy heuristic by 0.66 dB on vessels, 2.3 dB on thin vessels and 1.9 dB on the foreground. To understand this gap we compared the oracle with the heuristic region by region. On training patients, the oracle spends 2.3 times more of its budget on a 2 mm shell below the liver surface, 3.3 times more on thin vessels and 1.5 times more on tumour, and half as much on the parenchyma surrounding vessels; the same pattern holds on the test patients (Fig. 7 a). A gradient-boosted regression of the cell-wise log-ratio between oracle and heuristic densities on interpretable features explains 42% of its variance on held-out patients, with depth below the surface as the dominant variable (permutation importance 0.69, next 0.09): the oracle favours cells near the surface and starves deep tissue (Fig. 7 b; densities of one patient in Fig. 8 ). In a translucent volume, deep cells are seen through attenuating tissue and contribute less to every image, which is the visibility term of ( 2 ). The neural prior removes this depth bias and VACF halves it (Fig. 7 b).

blocks.en: We compared the normalised allocation densities of budget-capped teachers at 25K, 50K, 100K and 200K on training patients with the variability between two optimisation seeds at the same budget (Fig. 9 b). At 8 mm resolution the Jensen–Shannon divergence between budgets is 0.069 (25K vs 50K), 0.050 (50K vs 100K) and 0.038 (100K vs 200K), against seed floors of 0.078 at 25K and 0.033 at 200K; only the widest pair (25K vs 200K, 0.087) slightly exceeds the floor of the smaller budget. We did not test invariance at 2 mm or below 25K; there the support is empirical: a single density per patient, with no budget-specific fitting, gives the results of Sections 5.1 – 5.3 at 10K–100K.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Where the Gaussians of a cinematic CT scene should go under a fixed budget turns out to be predictable from the anatomy and the rendering setup. Learned once from optimised scenes, the front end places a budget of 10K–100K Gaussians as well as per-patient optimisation does (neural prior) or nearly so (VACF), on held-out and external patients, and raises vessel and thin-vessel quality by several decibels over uniform placement and over pruning a dense voxel-aligned model. It removes the placement search from the per-patient pipeline and gives exact control over the count, which display hardware requires. As an initialisation, the closed-form allocation also makes the remaining per-patient optimisation more effective: starting from the right number of Gaussians in the right places, position optimisation surpasses per-patient densification on vessels at 10K Gaussians and, at 25K, reaches a higher vessel PSNR after 118 s than densification after 248 s of optimisation.
blocks.zh: 电影CT场景的高斯人 应该在固定的预算下进行 从解剖学和渲染结构来看是可预测的 前端从优化场景中吸取教训后,将10K-100K高斯人的预算以及每名病人的优化(神经病前)或几乎是(VACF),提供给被扣留的病人和外部病人,并通过几个分化器提高船只和稀释物的质量,而不是统一放置和挤压密集的排毒模式。 它将放置搜索从每个病人的管道中移除,并对显示硬件需要的计数进行精确控制. 作为初始化,封闭式分配还使剩余的每个患者优化化效果更好:从合适的高斯人人数开始,位置优化化超过了10K高斯人船上的每个患者密度,在25K时,在118秒后达到高于248秒的PSNR。

blocks.en: The neural prior is the more accurate allocator wherever its inputs look like its training data: it matches the per-patient oracle on the internal and external test sets and, on vessels, under the label-free preset, whose extinction contrast resembles preset A. It learns, however, whatever its TF inputs encode about the training preset, and it under-serves thin vessels when a new TF changes the extinction contrast (preset B). VACF is within a fraction of a decibel of the oracle on vessels with seven readable parameters, which are stable across cell sizes. It transfers to new colours, extinctions and lighting because its tissue terms do not depend on them, and for the same reason it fails when appearance stops following the labels (preset C). Without its TF inputs, the neural prior behaves like VACF. Each implementation is therefore only as good as the agreement between its inputs and what is rendered: for a viewer with a label-aware TF in which users change colours, VACF or the neural prior without TF inputs is the safe choice; for an intensity-based TF, an appearance-aware allocator is required. That the closed form’s failure can be stated in one sentence in advance is an argument for interpretable allocators in clinical software.
blocks.zh: 神经前置是更精确的分泌器,只要其输入物看起来像其培训数据:它与内部和外部测试机组以及船舶上无标签预置物上的每位病人预示物相匹配,其灭绝对比类似于预置A. 然而,它学习了TF输入的关于训练预设的编码,当一个新的TF改变灭绝对比时,它会将薄薄的船服(预设B). VACF位于有7个可读参数的容器上甲骨文分解的一小部分之内,这些参数在细胞大小之间是稳定的. 它转移至新的颜色,灭绝和照明,因为其组织术语并不依赖于它们,同样的原因,当出现停止跟随标签(预设C)时,它失效. 没有它的TF输入,神经前置表现像VACF. 因此,每次执行都只好于其投入与提供内容之间的协议:对于一个具有标签意识TF的查看器,用户在其中改变颜色,VACF或者没有TF输入之前的神经是安全选择;对于基于强度的TF,需要一个外观意识分配器. 封闭式表格的失败可以提前一句话说明,这是临床软件中可解释分配器的理由。

blocks.en: The front end decides positions only. Complete scenes still require path-traced training views of each patient and per-patient fitting of colour, opacity and shape (about 2 min per patient here, in addition to path tracing), so this work does not yet deliver scenes in one forward pass; a feed-forward attribute decoder in the spirit of Render-FM, fed with our positions, is the natural complement. Neither implementation is robust to every TF: training an appearance-aware prior across a distribution of TFs, rather than on one preset, is the obvious next step. Combining the front end with label-aware training as in LAGS, which we did not evaluate, may add further gains on structures. Finally, the study covers one organ and one task, and we measured image quality rather than clinical utility or on-device frame rates.
blocks.zh: 前端只决定位置. 完整的场景仍需要每个病人和每个病人的路径跟踪训练观点,配色,不透明,形状(这里每个病人约2分钟,除了路径跟踪),因此,这部作品还没有在前行一个通道中呈现场景;一个以Render-FM精神为素材的向导属性解码器,并配以我们的位置,是自然的补充. 对每个工作队来说,这两个方案的执行都不够有力:在分发工作队之前就培训一种外观意识,而不是在一个预先设定上,是明显的下一步。 将前端与像LAGS那样的具有标签意识的培训结合起来,我们没有评估,可能会在结构方面进一步增加收益。 最后,该研究涉及一个器官和一个任务,我们测量了图像质量,而不是临床实用性或设备安装帧率。

blocks.en: The oracle is defined by one 3DGS optimiser with generic densification; ground truth comes from one renderer and one camera distribution, and test views share the training views’ sphere; the presets are three points in a large space of TFs and lights, and presets B and C were evaluated on 10 patients. Position optimisation was evaluated for VACF and baselines but not for the neural prior, and the neural prior was trained on 2 mm cells only, although 1 mm cells improve both VACF and the oracle at small budgets. The MSD test set was evaluated in two rounds and extended afterwards (Section 4.4 ); the external patients and the unseen presets, which were never used for any decision, corroborate the conclusions. The budgets studied (10K–100K) overlap those considered for a standalone headset by Li et al. (2026) (50K–200K), but the relation between budget and frame rate depends on the device and renderer, and we did not measure it.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We separated the question of where a fixed budget of Gaussians should go from the per-patient optimisation that usually answers it, and showed that a label-aware allocation front end, learned once from optimised scenes, answers it for new patients without per-patient optimisation. A population-trained neural prior matches the allocations of per-patient optimisation on internal and external patients; an interpretable visibility-aware closed form comes within a fraction of a decibel on vessels in under a second; both raise anatomical rendering quality far above uniform placement and pruning at equal budgets, and, as an initialisation, the closed form gives position optimisation a better start than densification. Rendering presets delimit when each implementation can be trusted. Attribute fitting remains per patient; deciding where the Gaussians go no longer has to.

blocks.en: Four pitfalls shaped the protocol and are reported for reproducibility. (i) An early go/stop experiment, run with 64 training views at 256 spp and 7K-iteration fits, found the oracle within 0.1 dB of the anatomy heuristic; noise-limited ground truth (about 39 dB on the liver at 256 spp) and view-limited overfitting (training-view PSNR rising while test PSNR fell as models grew) had compressed all differences. With 256 training views at 1024 spp, a real oracle gap appeared. (ii) Per-patient teachers barely densify on soft translucent images with default thresholds, so their densities mostly reflected their initialisation until absolute-gradient densification at a lower threshold was used. (iii) Smoothing the teacher count maps to suppress sampling noise moved thin-vessel mass into neighbouring cells (thin-vessel share of the budget 2.4% → \to 0.5%), so allocators fitted to smoothed targets, including the first-round closed form evaluated on the test set, under-served thin vessels; the raw-count likelihood is unbiased and the model itself provides the smoothing. (iv) A mismatch between the cells over which the neural prior was trained and those over which it was normalised at inference leaked a fifth of its budget outside the organ (Section 4.4 ); allocation densities should be audited by region before they are evaluated by image quality.
blocks.zh: 四个陷阱塑造了协议,并报告可复制。 (i) 在256 spp和7K-iteratation的64个培训观点下,进行早期的走/站试验,在解剖学的0.1 dB范围内发现了甲骨文;噪音有限的地面真理(在256 spp的肝脏上大约39 dB)和视线有限的偏差(培训-观点的PSNR上升,而测试的PSNR随着模型的增长而下降)压缩了所有差异。 由于在1024 spp有256种培训观点,出现了真正的甲骨文缺口. (二) 患者的教师在带有默认阈值的软透明图像上几乎不会变密度,因此他们的密度大多反映了他们的初始化,直到使用较低阈值的绝对梯度密度。 (三)平滑教师计数图以抑制采样噪音将稀释物质量移入邻近细胞(预算的稀释量占2.4%~\%~0.5%),因此配有平滑目标的分配器,包括在试验集上评价的首轮封闭式,服务不足的稀释器;原始计数可能性不带偏见,模型本身提供平滑. (四) 神经病以前接受过训练的细胞与经推断已恢复正常的细胞之间的不匹配情况,泄露了器官外五分之一的预算(第4.4节);分配密度应先按区域加以审计,然后再根据图像质量进行评估。
